C0.quote: We model the conference-author interactions as a Stackelberg game
C0.note: The paper analyses conference peer review as a Stackelberg game between a conference and authors who decide whether to (re)submit. Reviews are noisy signals about paper quality, and reviewers have no agency in the model. This is not a procedure that aggregates several agents' inputs into a collective decision by voting; it is closer to mechanism design for peer review. Coding stopped.
